name: local-day-cab
about: A local day-cab job paid by the hour, home daily, with benefits listed in a sentence.

input.page_text:
Local Class A Driver – Day Cab
Lakeshore Freight | Gary, IN
$29.50 per hour, overtime after 40 hours
Home daily. Day shift, 5:00 AM start.
Equipment: day cab tractors with 53' dry vans, no touch freight.
Benefits include medical, dental, a 401(k) with a 4% match and paid time off from your first year.
Minimum 2 years of Class A experience. Must pass a DOT physical and drug screen.
Equal Opportunity Employer.
